name: Lissajous Grid
desc: A full-bleed oscilloscope wall of Lissajous figures — one glowing curve per cell at an integer frequency ratio (column = x-freq, row = y-freq) — the whole matrix precessing on a drifting phase term so every cell morphs open to closed forever; renders as a spectral-scope rainbow, green phosphor CRT, amber terminal, white-on-blue blueprint, or electric neon.

energy.doc: glow / exposure amplitude of the curves

scale.doc: curve size within each cell (>1 overflows into neighbors)

harmon.doc: harmonic multiplier on every frequency (busier figures)
